system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are a helpful assistant that is great at website design, navigation, and executing tasks for the user.
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed system message; task-specific content goes in user turns.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a fine-tuned small LM is used to rank the elements present on a webpage, yielding a small pool of promising candidates
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: retrieval is neural cross-encoder ranking over DOM elements, not BM25 and not embedding vector store; no agent navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we utilize the candidate set to prune the webpage snapshot and construct snippets that only include the selected candidates and their neighbours as inputs to an LLM
context_compaction.note: Observation (HTML) pruning; history is only a list of previous action strings.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Our current approach, MINDACT, models the web environment using only textual context from webpage snapshots.

tool_call_format.note: Closest value: output is a plain-text multi-choice answer plus Action/Value lines parsed by the harness; no tool-call API, no JSON.

tool_count.evidence_quote: We support three common operations: Click (also including Hover and Press Enter ), Type, and Select Option .
tool_count.note: Operations, not function schemas; no tool-calling interface.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: We support three common operations: Click (also including Hover and Press Enter ), Type, and Select Option .

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: You can find the 3-shot prompt we use under: `src/action_prediction/llm_prompt.json`
tool_schema_source.note: Action options are hand-authored prompt text, not generated schemas.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The only requirement is that it should expose a `generate` function that takes the prompt and generate outputs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: We propose a two-stage process that synergizes the strength of small and large LMs
loop_primitives.note: Candidate generation then action prediction, per step, over offline cached steps.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the LM is trained to instead select from a list of options
planning_granularity.note: No planning step or plan object in the prompt.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a two-stage model that involves first using a fine-tuned small LM to filter the web elements and then using an LLM to select from the filtered elements
multi_agent_topology.note: Two specialised LMs in fixed hand-off; not conversational agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After obtaining the top-k candidates, we utilize the candidate set to prune the webpage snapshot and construct snippets
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed hand-off from ranking LM to prediction LLM; no agent spawning.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the user provides a single description of the task goal up front, and the agent carries out the task from start to finish

short_term_state.evidence_quote: At each step, it also receives the current webpage and the history of previous actions.
short_term_state.note: State is a task description plus a structured previous-action list, not a chat history.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we encode each webpage independently at every step, with only the previous actions provided as historical context

state_persistence.evidence_quote: we encode each webpage independently at every step, with only the previous actions provided as historical context
state_persistence.note: No resume path in the evaluation scripts.

self_verification.evidence_quote: This process repeats until a single element is selected, or all options are rejected by the model
self_verification.note: Multi-round option elimination is selection, not verification; no tests/linters/judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Each step of the task is evaluated independently with the ground truth action history provided.

rollback.evidence_quote: the task will fail immediately if an action was not cached during data collection

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each step of the task is evaluated independently with the ground truth action history provided.
termination_condition.note: Run ends when the cached annotated action sequence is exhausted; no model-declared finish action.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: llm_rate_limit`: Set the rate limit to avoid exceeding the OpenAI API limit.
cost_controls.note: Rate limit only; no budget, caching or routing. top_k reduced to 10 for GPT-4 'due to limited budget' is a manual choice.

timeouts.evidence_quote: llm_rate_limit`: Set the rate limit to avoid exceeding the OpenAI API limit.
timeouts.note: No timeout settings found in the config/evaluation files listed.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we evaluate the system with cached offline environments, which allows us to test using snapshots of complex real-world websites
execution_isolation.note: Offline cached HTML processed in-process; no live execution environment.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: we evaluate the system with cached offline environments, which allows us to test using snapshots of complex real-world websites
filesystem_access.note: Agent only reads cached snapshots; relative to the in-process boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: we evaluate the system with cached offline environments
network_policy.note: Agent actions do not touch the network (only the OpenAI API call itself).

permission_model.evidence_quote: the LM is trained to instead select from a list of options
permission_model.note: No authorisation layer; predicted action is scored directly.

tracing.evidence_quote: you will see three files: `*_outputs*.json`, `*_predictions*.json` and `*_results*.json`

replayability.evidence_quote: we include complete network traffic in the dataset, presenting possibilities for future research to enable some degree of replay and exploration within the cached environment

eval_hooks.note: evaluate.py / evaluate_llm.py / metric.py ship in the repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: the accompanying safety considerations for real-world deployment cannot be ignored
guardrails.note: Safety discussed as future work; no filters or action policies implemented.

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first dataset for developing and evaluating generalist agents for the web

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: You can also implement your own model and use it for evaluation. The only requirement is that it should expose a `generate` function
